text:
Type: set of two knitted hanging baskets
Use: storing small toys and odds and ends, hung from a hook or set on a shelf; children's room, playroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: knitted polyester cord, contrasting knitted hanging loop
Colors: bright green, hot pink loop
Shape: two soft round baskets in different sizes with ribbed knitted walls and a single loop handle, slouchy and flexible, small and light
Feel: playful, soft, cheerful, bright
Goes with: white furniture, light wood, bold colors, peg rails; colorful children's rooms and playrooms

product.name: STICKAT
product.description: Space-saving baskets that help to keep your childrens belongings organised.
